_about: Ethyl acetate (1) + acetic acid (2): excess molar enthalpy at 323.15 K and 1548.0 kPa from Brandt et al. (2014). Rows as in the ThermoML Archive record: mole fraction of ethyl acetate, excess molar enthalpy in kJ/mol (as printed).

source.citation: S. Brandt, S. Horstmann, S. Steinigeweg, J. Gmehling, Phase equilibria and excess properties for binary systems in reactive distillation processes Part II. Ethyl acetate synthesis, Fluid Phase Equilib. 376 (2014) 48-54
source.access: Journal article is subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 5: acetic acid + ethyl acetate, excess molar enthalpy, variable mole fraction of ethyl acetate, constraints T = 323.15 K and P = 1548.0 kPa. The table number in the article was not checked (article not open).

notes: Expanded uncertainties in the record: 0.005 to 0.0167 kJ/mol. Used as a check of the activity-model parameters, not fitted. Values as stored in the ThermoML record (XML file), extracted with validation/python/thermoml_read.py; nothing converted or rounded. To be checked by a person against the record before use (AGENTS.md rule 4).
